modules.title: 请求换到不同实例时，什么状态必须仍然可见
多实例部署增加了什么、还缺什么

items.title: 多个实例分担请求并提供接管机会
items.text: 入口可以把请求分到多个相同服务实例；一个实例维护或故障时，其他健康实例仍可能接收请求。副本数和分配方式要与真实服务目标一起验证，不能只看部署页面显示了几个进程。

items.title: 跨请求状态不能藏在单个实例里
items.text: 用户第一次请求落到 instance-a、下一次落到 instance-b 时，若会话只在 a 的本地内存，b 就无法识别用户。把会话等状态放到共享或外置存储后，分别让同一用户命中不同实例并确认仍保持登录状态，才能证明改善有效；这仍不代表数据库自动高可用或业务协调已经正确。

items.title: 定时报表会暴露另一种多实例问题
items.text: 日报服务扩到多个实例后，每个实例都可能同时触发同一份报表。要用共享任务记录或唯一执行规则协调，避免同一份日报被重复生成和发送。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 多实例部署解决的是同一个服务有多个运行副本，以及请求可以在它们之间分配；它不是数据库复制或数据库高可用的同义词。多个实例也不会自动共享本地会话、协调并发写入或保证跨服务操作一致，相关状态和规则仍要单独设计与验收。

lessonPractice.title: 多实例服务上线后，用户偶尔被要求重新登录。先检查哪一处？

options.label: 检查请求是否被分到不同实例，以及登录会话是否只保存在某个实例本地
options.feedback: 对。跳到另一个实例时，本地会话不可见是多实例常见问题；要把会话放到共享位置或采用可验证的无状态方案。

options.label: 继续增加实例数量，实例越多就越能自动共享用户登录状态
options.feedback: 增加副本只改变请求承接数量，不会让各实例自动看到彼此的本地会话。

options.label: 只检查数据库是否有备份，就认为登录问题与实例状态无关
options.feedback: 数据库备份不能证明会话在实例之间可见；登录状态的存放位置仍需单独检查。

en.title: After a multi-instance release, users are occasionally asked to sign in again. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Check whether requests reach different instances and whether the session exists only in one instance's local memory
options.feedback: Correct. A local session is invisible after a request moves to another instance; use shared state or a verifiable stateless approach.

options.label: Add more instances because more replicas automatically share login state
options.feedback: More replicas change request capacity, not whether instances can see each other's local sessions.

options.label: Check only whether the database has backups and conclude instance state is unrelated
options.feedback: Backups do not prove sessions are visible across instances; the location of login state still needs inspection.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把这个无状态 Web 服务部署为多个实例，并确认请求能由入口分配到任一健康实例。检查登录会话、上传进度等需要跨请求保留的状态，不要只放在单个实例内存；改完后分别让同一用户连续命中不同实例，确认不会掉登录。另请明确这次多实例没有自动解决哪些数据库高可用和协调问题。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Deploy this stateless web service with multiple instances and confirm the entry point can send requests to any healthy instance. Inspect state that must survive across requests, such as login sessions and upload progress; do not keep it only in one instance's memory. After the change, send the same user's requests to different instances and verify the session remains valid. Also state which database high-availability and coordination problems this multi-instance setup does not solve automatically.

learning.assumes: You know an entry point can distribute requests to different running instances of one service.
learning.outcome: You can tell when sessions or other external state are needed and distinguish service redundancy from database high availability.

modules.title: What must remain visible when requests move between instances
What multi-instance deployment adds and leaves open

items.title: Multiple instances share requests and offer takeover
items.text: An entry point can route requests to several equivalent service instances; when one is maintained or fails, other healthy instances may continue serving traffic. Verify replica count and routing against the service goal instead of trusting a deployment page that merely lists processes.

items.title: Cross-request state cannot hide in one instance
items.text: If a user's first request reaches instance-a and the next reaches instance-b, b cannot identify the user when the session exists only in a's memory. Put session state and similar data in shared or external storage, then route the same user to different instances and verify the session remains valid. This still does not prove database high availability or correct business coordination.

items.title: Scheduled reports reveal another multi-instance issue
items.text: After a daily-report service scales to multiple instances, each instance may trigger the same report at the same time. Coordinate through a shared task record or a single-execution rule so the report is not generated and sent more than once.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Multi-instance deployment provides multiple runtime replicas of one service and a way to distribute requests; it is not a synonym for database replication or database high availability. Multiple instances do not automatically share local sessions, coordinate concurrent writes, or guarantee cross-service consistency; state and rules still need separate design and verification.
